rows.name: sky
rows.text: The sky appears blue because of a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering. When sunlight enters Earth's atmosphere, it collides with gas molecules and scatters in all directions. Shorter blue wavelengths are scattered more strongly than other colors, making the sky look blue to our eyes.
